source: Transcribed directly from FX-* Paragraph Style Options in FusionX_GEV_Sales_Brief_v2.indd — not designed fresh, this is what's actually shipping.

fontRoles.note: Not in the InDesign package's embedded Document Fonts folder — it's synced via Adobe Fonts rather than a local file. Team members need Adobe Fonts activated in InDesign for this to resolve. Same open-source family is available on Google Fonts for web/HTML collateral and this site.

Variable font (GX build), locally embedded and portable. Google Fonts hosts the standard Libre Franklin family — close enough for web use; confirm optical-size behavior matches if pixel-perfect parity matters.
Variable font, locally embedded and portable. Used only for FX-Stat — large numeric callouts, not general monospace/code use.

styles.name: FX-H2
styles.usage: Secondary headline — note: same point size as FX-Body, differentiated by family/weight only. Worth confirming this is intentional.

styles.name: FX-subhead
styles.usage: Subhead beneath H1/H2, wide tracking for emphasis at small size

styles.name: FX-Body3
styles.usage: Body variant with looser leading — likely for denser blocks or sidebar copy

styles.name: FX-Stat
styles.usage: Large numeric stat callouts — tight negative tracking for a dense, technical mark
